model_annotations.Bulgarian: Figure 5 (left) illustrates the proportion of SDPA output values below a certain threshold after gating, alongside sparsity measurements derived from multiplying the average gating score with pre-gating hidden states. The X-axis is labeled "Layer" and spans from 0 to 20 with a linear scale, marked at intervals of 5. The Y-axis is labeled "Sparsity ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2" and ranges from 0 to 1.0, also with a linear scale, and is marked at intervals of 0.2. The figure contains three lines: a blue dashed line representing the "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03", a blue solid line for the "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44", and a green dashed line for the "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33". The blue dashed line starts at approximately 0.35 on the Y-axis at Layer 0 and decreases to around 0.25 by Layer 5, then gradually declines further to about 0.2 by Layer 20. The blue solid line begins at roughly 0.35 at Layer 0, drops sharply to approximately 0.1 by Layer 5, and continues to decrease more gradually to around 0.05 by Layer 20. The green dashed line starts at about 0.35 at Layer 0, falls to around 0.25 by Layer 5, and then remains relatively stable, ending at approximately 0.25 by Layer 20.

The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 20 with a tick label interval of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output" and also has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1 with a tick label interval of 0.2. The plot contains three lines: a blue dashed line representing the "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.33", a green solid line representing the "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44", and a dotted green line representing the "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33". The blue dashed line starts at approximately 0.35 at layer 0, decreases to around 0.25 at layer 5, and then gradually increases to about 0.8 at layer 20. The green solid line begins at roughly 0.3 at layer 0, drops to approximately 0.2 at layer 5, and then steadily rises to around 0.9 at layer 20. The dotted green line starts at about 0.3 at layer 0, decreases to approximately 0.2 at layer 5, and then gradually increases to around 0.85 at layer 20.
